summary: Completed comprehensive E2E code audit for WatchNexus C#/.NET 10 backend. ALL 24 API tests passed. All requested features verified working: login returns access_token, system info/stats, Crumbs API Management with 8 services, Weather/Podcasts/Radio gadgets, IPTV/Subtitles/Playlists, qBittorrent status, themes, gadgets, user preferences, cache/db stats, filesystem browse. Frontend loads correctly with sidebar navigation and Settings/API Management page displaying all services grouped by category.

issues: Shows 0°C as default/loading state before location is configured - should show prompt to set location first

auth_login.details: POST /api/auth/login with email/password returns access_token correctly

system_info.details: GET /api/system/info returns version 2.6.5, hostname, platform info

crumbs_services.details: GET /api/crumbs/services returns 8 services: tmdb, opensubtitles, addic7ed, subscene, podnapisi, yifysubtitles, qbittorrent, openweathermap

crumbs_configured.details: GET /api/crumbs/configured returns list of configured API keys

crumbs_put_tmdb.details: PUT /api/crumbs/tmdb saves TMDB API key correctly and persists in DB

weather_with_coords.details: GET /api/gadgets/weather?lat=51&lon=0 returns weather data from Open-Meteo with temperature 8.7°C

weather_search.details: GET /api/gadgets/weather/search?q=London returns 10 location results with lat/lon

radio_stations.details: GET /api/gadgets/radio/stations?limit=5 returns 5 radio stations from Radio Browser API

radio_countries.details: GET /api/gadgets/radio/countries returns 237 countries with station counts

iptv_sources.details: GET /api/iptv/sources returns IPTV sources list (currently empty, ready for M3U)

subtitles_settings.details: GET /api/subtitles/settings returns all 5 providers: opensubtitles, addic7ed, subscene, podnapisi, yifysubtitles + languages + auto_download

drizzle_create_playlist.details: POST /api/drizzle/playlists creates new playlist and returns id, name, status=created

qbittorrent_status.details: GET /api/qbittorrent/status returns {connected: false, status: 'not_configured'} (expected - no qBit WebUI)

ripen_installed.details: GET /api/ripen/installed returns 5 installed gadgets: weather, podcasts, radio, photos, webvideo

frontend_login.details: Login page loads with email/password fields, Sign In button works correctly

frontend_settings.details: Settings page loads with sidebar navigation showing General, Users & Access, Media Libraries, Media Health under Core Settings; API Management, Indexers, Download Client under Integrations

frontend_crumbs.details: API Management (Crumbs) page displays all 8 services grouped by category (Metadata, Subtitles, Downloads, Gadgets). Clicking service opens editor panel with fields, Enable toggle, Test and Save buttons

frontend_weather.details: Weather gadget page loads with temperature display, 7-Day Forecast section, Change Location and Refresh buttons

critical_code_review_comments: All 8 Crumbs API Management services correctly implemented in CrumbsController.cs
Weather/Radio/Podcasts gadgets use REAL external APIs (Open-Meteo, Radio Browser, iTunes)
Frontend CrumbsSettings.jsx correctly displays all services by category with editor panel
All endpoints properly secured with JWT Bearer auth
seed_data_creation: None required - test user exists in SQLite

VPN WireGuard and qBittorrent are the only MOCKED integrations (require external infrastructure). All gadget APIs use real external services.
